Failed password and TOTP attempts now count toward one username limit across all client IPs, alongside the existing IP limit. Existing settings apply: defaults remain 8 failures within 15 minutes and a 15-minute lockout. Account lockouts also apply from internal networks; existing sessions remain valid.

Fix forwarding-adapter command editing to submit the current definition while preserving arguments and execution limits. Repair guidance now explains that correcting an adapter can restore its bound rules without recreating them.

Update the server and frontend together. This release requires no database migration or agent update from v0.5.40.
